S.FORM: sua iisi ia, kanakanavu tamna kaari iisi.
S.PHON: sua iiʂi ia kanakanavu tamna kaari iiʂi
S.FORM: sua iisi ia, kanakanavu tamna kaari iisi.
S.PHON: sua iiʂi ia kanakanavu tamna kaa[r|ɾ]i iiʂi

S.FORM: makaasə sua taamu ia, kaʔan taavalaʔ-ən t<um>ani-ulaʔə.
S.PHON: makaasə sua taamu ia kaʔan taavaɾaʔən tumaniuɾaʔə
S.FORM: makaase sua taamu ia, ka'an taavara'en t<um>aniura'e.
S.PHON: makaase sua taamu ia kaʔan taava[r|ɾ]aʔen tumaniu[r|ɾ]aʔe
S.TRANSL: As for a hundred pacer, (we) cannot abuse it.

S.FORM: si iisua=kani ia, ni-m-uru-ʔucaŋ misai, maraa kaʔan=pa=ku taavalaʔə kaari iisi.
S.PHON: ʂi iisuakani ia nimuruʔuʦaŋ misai maraa kaʔanpaku taavaɾaʔə kaari iiʂi
S.FORM: si iisuakani ia, nimuru'ucang misai, maraa ka'anpaku taavara'e kaari iisi.
S.PHON: ʂi iisuakani ia nimu[r|ɾ]uʔuʦaŋ misai ma[r|ɾ]aa kaʔanpaku taava[r|ɾ]aʔe kaa[r|ɾ]i iiʂi
S.TRANSL: Although there is a myth about a hundred pacer that married (a woman), I don't quite understand it.

S.FORM: maamia taavalaʔ-an=aku ia, ma-maaraŋ miana ia, maica=kia caa-caan, ʔuuna-ini taamu ʔaisi caa-caan, ʔapacuaʔ-ai vaʔuru-ini vanəkavuka nakəvə ia, m-ara-pici=kia m-ara-tiʔiŋ pita-kusa ʔinia makaasə "pa-tikur-au mu-caan-a," kisa-ən.
S.PHON: maamia taavaɾaʔanaku ia mamaaraŋ miana ia maiʦakia ʦaaʦaan ʔuunaini taamu ʔaiʂi ʦaaʦaan ʔapaʦuaʔai vaʔuruini vanəkavuka nakəvə ia marapitʂikia maratiʔiŋ pitakusa ʔinia makaasə patikurau muʦaana kisaən
S.FORM: maamia taavara'anaku ia, mamaarang miana ia, maicakia caacaan, 'uunaini taamu 'aisi caacaan, 'apacua'ai va'uruini vanekavuka nakeve ia, marapicikia marati'ing pitakusa 'inia makaase "patikurau mucaana," kisaen.
S.PHON: maamia taava[r|ɾ]aʔanaku ia mamaa[r|ɾ]aŋ miana ia maiʦakia ʦaaʦaan ʔuunaini taamu ʔaiʂi ʦaaʦaan ʔapaʦuaʔai vaʔu[r|ɾ]uini vanekavuka nakeve ia ma[r|ɾ]apitʂikia ma[r|ɾ]atiʔiŋ pitakusa ʔinia makaase patiku[r|ɾ]au muʦaana kisaen
S.TRANSL: As far as I know, when elders crossed a path where there was a hundred pacer, even though we may wear new trousers or clothes, we should cut them into pieces and throw them to it and say, "Please wear them and leave."

S.FORM: mu-a-ca sua taamu mu-vanvaanə taanaasa-ini=kara sa kaʔan=kara, kaʔan=kia taavalaʔə.
S.PHON: muaʦa sua taamu muvanvaanə taanaasainikara sa kaʔankara kaʔankia taavaɾaʔə
S.FORM: muaca sua taamu muvanvaane taanaasainikara sa ka'ankara, ka'ankia taavara'e.
S.PHON: muaʦa sua taamu muvanvaane taanaasainika[r|ɾ]a sa kaʔanka[r|ɾ]a kaʔankia taava[r|ɾ]aʔe
S.TRANSL: A hundred pacer went to an area around its habitat (in a bush), but I'm not sure.

S.FORM: pu-a-tu-tuturu=ku kaari iisi, ʔuuna=ku c<in>əʔəra ma-maaraŋ miana.
S.PHON: puatututuruku kaari iiʂi ʔuunaku tʂinəʔəra mamaaraŋ miana
S.FORM: puatututuruku kaari iisi, 'uunaku c<in>e'era mamaarang miana.
S.PHON: puatututu[r|ɾ]uku kaa[r|ɾ]i iiʂi ʔuunaku tʂineʔe[r|ɾ]a mamaa[r|ɾ]aŋ miana
S.TRANSL: I'm saying these words (because) an elder and I saw (the whole process) in the past (around last year, as noted in the field notes).

S.FORM: ma-manəŋə vanəkavuk=kian.
S.PHON: mamanəŋə vanəkavukkian
S.FORM: mamanenge vanekavukkian.
S.PHON: mamaneŋe vanekavukkian

S.FORM: ʔacu=kia ni-ru-aimi ŋanai-ini.
S.PHON: ʔaʦukia niruaimi ŋanaiini
S.FORM: 'acukia niruaimi nganaiini.
S.PHON: ʔaʦukia ni[r|ɾ]uaimi ŋanaiini

S.FORM: maa-məə-məəkə=kia m-ari-avici ʔikua ma-maaraŋ miana. c<əm>əʔəra=kimi taamu ʔaisi caa-caan.
S.PHON: maaməəməəkəkia mariavitʂi ʔikua mamaaraŋ miana ʦəməʔərakimi taamu ʔaiʂi ʦaaʦaan
S.FORM: maameemeekekia mariavici 'ikua mamaarang miana. c<em>e'erakimi taamu 'aisi caacaan.
S.PHON: maameemeekekia ma[r|ɾ]iavitʂi ʔikua mamaa[r|ɾ]aŋ miana ʦemeʔe[r|ɾ]akimi taamu ʔaiʂi ʦaaʦaan
S.TRANSL: The elders once took me (to a certain place). We happened to see a hundred pacer on a path.

S.FORM: para-pic-a-ini ʔinia vanəkavuka-ini pita-kusa na taamu.
S.PHON: parapiʦaini ʔinia vanəkavukaini pitakusa na taamu
S.FORM: parapicaini 'inia vanekavukaini pitakusa na taamu.
S.PHON: pa[r|ɾ]apiʦaini ʔinia vanekavukaini pitakusa na taamu
S.TRANSL: He cut his trousers into pieces and threw them at the hundred pacer.

S.FORM: "mu-caan-a si tia=ta-paica-a=mia mu-caan."
S.PHON: muʦaana ʂi tiatapaiʦaamia muʦaan
S.FORM: "mucaana si tiatapaicaamia mucaan."
S.PHON: muʦaana ʂi tiatapaiʦaamia muʦaan
S.TRANSL: "Go away because we are crossing the path!"

S.FORM: makaasua=cu ara-takaarə sua taamu ma-kaasi ʔacu mu-a-suvuku na rəmər-a.
S.PHON: makaasuaʦu aratakaarə sua taamu makaaʂi ʔaʦu muasuvuku na rəməra
S.FORM: makaasuacu aratakaare sua taamu makaasi 'acu muasuvuku na remera.
S.PHON: makaasuaʦu a[r|ɾ]atakaa[r|ɾ]e sua taamu makaaʂi ʔaʦu muasuvuku na [r|ɾ]eme[r|ɾ]a
S.TRANSL: The hundred pacer raised (its head) and went towards the bush in the mountain.

S.FORM: iimu ma-kaasi ma-maaraŋ miana, "ʔakuni=ʔai t<um>ani-ulaʔə kulai, misai, taamu," misa.
S.PHON: iimu makaaʂi mamaaraŋ miana ʔakuniʔai tumaniuɾaʔə kuɾai misai taamu misa
S.FORM: iimu makaasi mamaarang miana, "'akuni'ai t<um>aniura'e kurai, misai, taamu," misa.
S.PHON: iimu makaaʂi mamaa[r|ɾ]aŋ miana ʔakuniʔai tumaniu[r|ɾ]aʔe ku[r|ɾ]ai misai taamu misa
S.TRANSL: That is why elders in the past said, "Don't abuse any snake, namely hundred pacer!"

S.FORM: makaasua kari=maku sua ʔa-ta-paica-a sian pu-kari-kari, ʔa-pa-timana kamua ma-manu taa-tiʔiŋ.
S.PHON: makaasua karimaku sua ʔatapaiʦaa ʂian pukarikari ʔapatimana kamua mamanu taatiʔiŋ
S.FORM: makaasua karimaku sua 'atapaicaa sian pukarikari, 'apatimana kamua mamanu taati'ing.
S.PHON: makaasua ka[r|ɾ]imaku sua ʔatapaiʦaa ʂian puka[r|ɾ]ika[r|ɾ]i ʔapatimana kamua mamanu taatiʔiŋ
S.TRANSL: My words are to pass on (by a recording) to you young people to listen to them carefully.

S.FORM: t<um>ana-a iikita kanakanavu.
S.PHON: tumanaa iikita kanakanavu
S.FORM: t<um>anaa iikita kanakanavu.
S.PHON: tumanaa iikita kanakanavu
S.TRANSL: We Kanakanavu people should listen carefully.

S.FORM: kaʔan=kita taavalaʔə t<um>ani-ulaʔə taamu.
S.PHON: kaʔankita taavaɾaʔə tumaniuɾaʔə taamu
S.FORM: ka'ankita taavara'e t<um>aniura'e taamu.
S.PHON: kaʔankita taava[r|ɾ]aʔe tumaniu[r|ɾ]aʔe taamu
S.TRANSL: We should not abuse any hundred pacer.

S.FORM: ŋuaci kari=maku
S.PHON: ŋuatʂi karimaku
S.FORM: nguaci karimaku
S.PHON: ŋuatʂi ka[r|ɾ]imaku

S.FORM: ara-siŋsiŋ-a.
S.PHON: araʂiŋʂiŋa
S.FORM: arasingsinga.
S.PHON: a[r|ɾ]aʂiŋʂiŋa
